benchmarks.timed_boundary: Compiled-layout in-memory decodeRange/decoder dispatch and per-record checksum only; fixture and layout setup excluded
benchmarks.input: Deterministic approximately 8 MiB raw fixed-width records per configuration, little and big endian
benchmarks.execution: Single-context std.Io clock; no parser task scheduling
benchmarks.consumer: XOR of decoded scalar bits; checksum printed after the timed trials
benchmarks.memory: No decoder-owned allocation inside the measured primitive; total process memory not reported
benchmarks.limitations: Pure decoder results cannot be compared with parser lifecycle throughput

benchmarks.timed_boundary: Parser.init and layout compilation excluded; timed nextRawChunkForTesting or next and checksum; parser.deinit outside timer
benchmarks.input: Memory-backed deterministic binary XYZ f32, 3M records; 64 KiB to 16 MiB chunks
benchmarks.execution: Caller-provided process std.Io; compare producer, record decoder, typed columns
benchmarks.consumer: Producer mode hashes only first/last bytes of each chunk; record and columns modes hash decoded data
benchmarks.memory: Reports raw-buffer capacity peak, not parser peak live plus reserved bytes
benchmarks.limitations: Different modes do unequal work; checksum differs by mode and accumulates over trials; not an end-to-end baseline

benchmarks.timed_boundary: Parser.init plus layout and storage setup excluded; timed generic record loop, direct/property-major column fill, or parser.next plus digest; deinit deferred beyond timer
benchmarks.input: Memory-backed fixed binary records, 200k records per schema, little and big endian
benchmarks.execution: Process std.Io, no controlled concurrency comparison
benchmarks.consumer: FNV-like hash traverses decoded values; digest checked across decode variants
benchmarks.memory: Reports backing allocator allocation calls during timed section, not parser peak live/reserved
benchmarks.limitations: Record/column/next variants include different work; values comparable only within the specified experiment

benchmarks.timed_boundary: Parser.init -> Parser.next, column traversal/digest -> Parser.deinit; fixture generation outside timer
benchmarks.input: Warm-memory fixed binary XYZ f32, 500k/3M/10M records, 256 KiB chunks
benchmarks.execution: Single and native std.Io.Threaded capacities 2, 4, 8; ordered and unordered
benchmarks.consumer: Order-independent decoded-point digest checked against fixture
benchmarks.memory: Reports parser peak memory and native scheduling counters
benchmarks.limitations: Binary XYZ only; cannot compare throughput numbers to dissimilar Phase 11 fixtures

benchmarks.timed_boundary: Three successive separate intervals: integer conversion, float conversion, and tokenization
benchmarks.input: Fixed token tables, 1M iterations per interval
benchmarks.consumer: Escaped mutable token tables and accumulated numeric/token counts prevent trivial elimination
benchmarks.limitations: No trial distribution or warmup; not an end-to-end throughput baseline

benchmarks.timed_boundary: Parser.init -> Parser.next, typed column consumer -> Parser.deinit; fixture generation outside timer
benchmarks.input: Warm-memory ASCII XYZ f32, 10k/500k/3M records, 256 KiB chunks
benchmarks.consumer: Accumulates x+y+z; validates record counts and expected sum
benchmarks.limitations: Single repeated ASCII record; checksum is a numeric sum rather than bitwise digest

benchmarks.timed_boundary: Parser.init -> Parser.next, typed scalar/list consumer -> Parser.deinit; generation outside timer
benchmarks.input: Warm-memory ASCII XYZ or triangle faces, 300k records, 256 KiB chunks
benchmarks.execution: Single, native threaded ordered and threaded unordered
benchmarks.consumer: Numeric sums validated against per-workload expected sum
benchmarks.memory: Reports parser peak_total_bytes and executor statistics
benchmarks.limitations: Repeated short records; sums do not verify every decoded bit

benchmarks.timed_boundary: Scan and chunk-assembly cases time only their component after layout/scanner setup; pipeline cases time Parser.init -> next/digest -> deinit
benchmarks.input: Warm-memory binary LE/BE triangles and mixed polygons, 300k records
benchmarks.execution: Single structural scanning/chunking; parser single ordered plus native threaded ordered/unordered
benchmarks.consumer: Scan/chunk verify counts, items, staged bytes; pipeline additionally validates item-value checksum
benchmarks.memory: Pipeline reports parser peak_total_bytes; scanning and assembly report copied spans, not global parser memory
benchmarks.limitations: Component and lifecycle measurements intentionally overlap; their durations are not additive or mutually comparable

benchmarks.timed_boundary: Delegates to binary_variable_pipeline.runMatrix: Parser.init -> next/digest -> deinit
benchmarks.input: Same deterministic LE/BE triangles and polygons; 16/64/256 MiB budgets, 64/256/1024 KiB chunks
benchmarks.consumer: Validates item counts, item checksum, and parser memory limit
benchmarks.memory: Reports parser peak_total_bytes and batch reductions
benchmarks.limitations: Configuration matrix is opt-in and uses shorter runs than the Phase 10 pipeline benchmark

benchmarks.timed_boundary: Parser.init -> next, decoded-column digest -> Parser.deinit; input generation and executor creation excluded
benchmarks.input: Warm-memory 250k records for seven binary/ASCII scalar/list workloads, 256 KiB and 8 KiB chunks
benchmarks.execution: Single ordered, std.Io.Threaded(4) ordered/unordered, and single small chunk
benchmarks.consumer: Commutative logical-record digest; exact record, item, digest and budget verification each sample
benchmarks.memory: Reports parser peak_total_bytes against 16 MiB budget and native submission metrics
benchmarks.limitations: Consistent interim baseline, but small warm-memory fixture and lifecycle-only timing; does not expose per-round samples or steady-state body time

benchmarks.timed_boundary: Separate monotonic intervals for Parser.next/column digest (body) and Parser.init through Parser.deinit (lifecycle); fixture creation, executor setup and reporting excluded
benchmarks.input: Deterministic 7 workloads from verified M16 fixture generator; configurable record count and 256 KiB/8 KiB chunk targets
benchmarks.execution: External single and native std.Io.Threaded(4) ordered and unordered; small-chunk single mode
benchmarks.consumer: All decoded values checked using M16 commutative record-indexed digest, count, list totals and memory budget for each trial
benchmarks.statistic: Each raw sample plus median/p05/p95 for lifecycle and body
benchmarks.memory: Parser peak_total_bytes maximum over trials, checked against configured budget; native and inline execution counters recorded
benchmarks.limitations: End-to-end warm-memory validation consumer. Component microbenchmarks remain separately scoped. No filesystem throughput or independent memory-bandwidth estimate.
